prompt:
The snippet snippets/shipping-policy-labels-2.liquid renders the shipping policy box on product pages. Several of its literal references are broken: Theme Check reports missing assets, missing translation keys and a missing snippet. Fix every broken literal operand so that each one points to a file or key that actually exists in the theme. Do not change anything else: keep the markup, classes, attributes, variable names (threshold, processing_days, show_badge), filter arguments (amount:, days:), the assign/render structure and whitespace control exactly as they are.

Rules for choosing the correct targets:
1. The stylesheet loaded with asset_url | stylesheet_tag must be the existing CSS file in assets/.
2. The icon image src must use the existing SVG file in assets/.
3. All translation keys must exist in locales/en.default.json. Use only keys nested under shipping.policy, and pick each key by meaning: the heading text, the free-shipping threshold line (interpolates amount), the processing time line (interpolates days), the returns window line, and the badge label.
4. The render tag must name the existing badge snippet in snippets/ and keep passing label: badge_label.

The finished file must produce no Theme Check errors for missing assets, translation keys or snippets. Read the files under assets/, locales/ and snippets/ to find the real names. Change only snippets/shipping-policy-labels-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
